'''Chapter 457''' is titled "Meeeeat!!!"

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page#Color Spread|Color Spread]]: Dressed as outlaws, [[Nico Robin|Robin]], [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]], [[Usopp]], [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]], and [[Sanji]] (the latter two riding a giant lizard) enter an Old West town.

==Short Summary==
[[Oars]] is awakened through [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]]'s shadow. [[Nami]], [[Usopp]] and [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]]'s position is revealed and they try to escape, but are pursued by [[Absalom]]. Absalom easily defeats Usopp and Chopper and captures Nami in the process. Usopp and Chopper are then surrounded by [[Zombie|zombies]] and are outnumbered but [[Nico Robin|Robin]] and [[Franky]] come in to save them.

==Long Summary==
[[Gecko Moria|Moria]] took [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]]'s shadow to resurrect the ultimate zombie [[Oars]]. Having witnessed what had happened, [[Usopp]] and [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] fall out into view, letting Moria and [[Perona]] know they were there. Immediately [[Absalom]] spots [[Nami]] claiming that she is his bride. He begins asking her is she doing there. The Wild Zombies attempt to capture them. Oars finally wakes up; Nami, Chopper and Usopp run away at full speed with Absalom running after them. While running away Nami sees that Oars' first word was meat figuring out what has happened to Luffy, [[Sanji]] and [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]]. Chopper gets angry because he finds out that [[Hogback]] wasn't a good doctor, and he didn't even care about peoples' lives; he is just a villain.

As they run to the [[Thousand Sunny]] where Luffy, Sanji and Zoro's bodies are, Absalom suddenly catches up to them abruptly burning Usopp and Chopper. He kidnaps Nami because he wants to marry her. Usopp attacks Absalom but it was too late since Absalom had already disappeared with Nami. A group of wild zombies then surround Chopper and Usopp isn't unable to beat all of them. They're suddenly helped by [[Nico Robin|Robin]] and [[Franky]].
